desc: 翻盖一提双饮，双层剖壳锁冷，细身稳落车载杯托
leaf: 曜石黑双层不锈钢真空保温水瓶（吸管口与直饮口双饮盖、带折返提环、细身可入车载杯托）
name: 曜石黑双层真空锁冷保温水瓶款

shots.intent: 用完整侧身黑剪影在搜索列表里一眼赢得点击，交付干净合规的平台主图。
把外壳与内胆剥开成悬浮环带，讲清双层夹壁的构造机制，替掉任何参数主张。
俯视微距拍开盖后的两条饮道，用真实结构证明一瓶两喝，取代任何口播式主张。
把水瓶放进通勤车内的杯托里，用真实情境回答放得下、带得走。
在纯黑场上放大掀起后的提环与铆轴，用做工细节支撑随手拎走的便利卖点。
立面尺寸线配素色礼盒同框，一次消除装不装得下与到手是什么的疑虑。
低角度仰拍拎包离手的户外一步，把携行便利转成可代入的自我画面。
俯视畅饮动作落在整块高饱和强调色上定格收口，把最后一句主张留给空白位。

style.backgroundSystem: one solid flat field per screen on an obsidian-noir chrome system: seamless pure white #FFFFFF for the packshot and the elevation screen, frost grey #E9EEF2 for the peeled-shell construction screen, brushed titanium #C9D1D9 for the lid macro, obsidian black #0E1013 for the carry-loop macro with its footer band inverted to frost grey, unbadged matte charcoal #2B2E33 car interior and open pale sky #BFD7E8 for the two in-context frames, one saturated volt lime block #C6F24E for the closing screen; a solid dark footer band #0E1013 runs along the bottom of every non-white screen; never a gradient, never a mottled texture, never a mixed or random environment
style.direction: obsidian noir chrome insulated drinkware commerce
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line leader arrows ending in one small volt lime #C6F24E dot marker, plus one blank thin-line circular pictogram ring sitting inside the dark footer band; flat matte, no glossy three-dimensional badges, no snowflake or thermometer glyphs
style.lightingSystem: bright even cool studio light with a front-left softbox key and a fill card, one narrow specular stripe running down the matte barrel, thin rim light on the dark screens so black plastic separates from black ground, skimming accent light that sweeps across moulded channels only on macro screens, soft contact shadows that always touch the ground, 5600K on the two daylight frames, no harsh blown speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent obsidian noir chrome insulated drinkware visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of obsidian black #0E1013, frost grey #E9EEF2, brushed titanium #C9D1D9 and one volt lime accent #C6F24E; one solid flat field per screen with no gradient, no mottled texture and no mixed environment; bright even cool studio lighting with a front-left softbox key and fill card, one narrow specular stripe down the matte barrel, thin rim light on the dark screens, skimming accent light only on macro screens, soft grounded contact shadows, 5600K on the two daylight frames; modern geometric sans-serif kept for post compositing while every rendered frame carries only blank rounded label plates, empty leader dots, empty dimension bars and one blank pill tag inside a solid dark footer band #0E1013; thin single-weight line leader arrows ending in a small volt lime #C6F24E dot marker and one blank thin-line circular pictogram ring, flat matte with no glossy badges; stable slim upright tapered cylinder with a domed flip lid, constant product scale and never-drifting matte black finish; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no gradient or textured backdrops, no invented spec numbers, units, hours or percentages.
noDrift: no invented spec numbers, units, hours or percentages
style.presentationRules: one constant silhouette and scale across screens: a slim upright tapered cylinder with a domed flip lid and a hinged carry loop that stays folded on packshots and elevation screens and is raised only on the loop macro and the two lifestyle frames; matte black body grain and the moulded lid seams never drift; hero angle stays consistent between the packshot, the spec elevation and the closing frame
style.surfaceSystem: seamless white sweep #FFFFFF, frost grey matte board #E9EEF2, brushed titanium plate #C9D1D9, a low obsidian plinth #0E1013 and one volt lime block #C6F24E; real surfaces stay limited to a matte charcoal car console #2B2E33 and a sunlit limestone ridge under open sky #BFD7E8
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif held back for post compositing only; every rendered frame carries blank rounded label plates, empty leader dots, empty dimension bars and one blank pill tag on the footer band, so no in-image copy is generated at all
